profile.headline: Atlassian Engineer / Developer
profile.summary:
As a seasoned professional in Atlassian suite administration and engineering, I bring a wealth of experience in optimizing collaborative environments. My journey has led me to administer, support, and evolve Atlassian's robust tools, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Fisheye/Crucible, both on-premise and in the cloud. My passion for continuous improvement extends to security, where I've addressed vulnerabilities by replacing Docker images, applying patches, and modifying configurations, enhancing system resilience.
I've played a pivotal role in cloud migrations and executed seamless upgrades, all while ensuring access and identity management with Active Directory. I'm committed to driving innovation and efficiency through technology, and I'm excited to connect and collaborate with professionals who share this passion. Let's explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Focusing on creating solutions leveraging Atlassian JiraSW, JiraSM, Rest API services, other Atlassian plug-ins and modules, and potentially other systems.

positions.title: Atlassian Engineer
positions.description:
• Administer, support, and evolve Atlassian's robust tools, Jira and Confluence.
• Develop Python scripts to implement ServiceNow - Jira integration.
• Develop tool scripts for tasks such as user group management and bulk issue import, etc.
• Onboarding / data migration support for various teams.
• Configure integrations with external systems.
• Administer access to Jira API, manage service accounts, and analyze API activities and logs.
• Customize workflows using Script Runner and JIRA Automation to automate state transitions, implement transition approval controls, and auto-fill sub-task creation.

positions.title: Sr. Atlassian Engineer
positions.description:
• Administered, maintained and upgraded the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and Fisheye) both on premise and on cloud.
• Developed Python scripts for data migration from older systems.
• Contributed to the technical aspects of cloud migration for Jira and Confluence.
• Developed complex Jira workflows, various configurations, screens, and permissions.
• Customized workflows in Jira using Script Runner and Jira Automation.
• Remediated vulnerabilities, applying patches, and modifying configurations.
• Planned and executed upgrades and migrations of Atlassian tools utilizing Docker Compose.

positions.title: Atlassian Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and customized complex Jira configurations including Workflows and Screen schemes to align them with the needs of various stakeholders.
• Ensure proper configuration management and version control of Jira instances and plugins
• Administered access and identity management with Atlassian Crowd.
positions.insights: System Administration, Amazon ECS and +8 skills

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon ECS, System Deployment and +3 skills
